dm-rfu4-graveyardrm.rfl.story: I decided to remaster my 2005 Graveyard map from RFU4. The basic layout is the same but pretty much everything has been rebuilt from scratch with way more detail. I spent about 75 days over the last 5 months working on this. The map has 3 unique areas connected via teleporters. Each area has its own skybox, fog settings, music and ambience. There is the above ground area with a mausoleum, cemetery and surrounded by forest. There are the catacombs underground and there is Hell in another dimension. The skybox and fog settings are set at each spawn point, so if you are spectating you will have the wrong skybox and fog if you fly to a different area then the one you were in when you died,...

dm_dvl-underhalls1-1.rfl.story: This is a remake of Doom 2, level 2 - Underhalls. The whole thing was originally made from scratch by eye, so it's not perfectly identical and scale isn't 1:1, but it's fairly close. I originally made this map in 2006, but decided it's time to add some modern enhancements and fix a few things. - Changed the teleporter in the secret area, from being a series of push regions the player could sometimes get stuck in, to an actual teleporter and added the original doom teleport effect sprite. - Added a sound and message when you first enter the secret area. - Linked the moving walls to clutter destruction and set the triggers to only be able to be activated once, so everything stays in sync...

dm-cyborg.rfl.story: This map is an homage to the biomechanoid art of H.R.Giger. In this art, Giger blurs the lines between natural and artifical beings. Most people are probably familiar with his Oscar winning designs used in the Alien movie series. The map take place in a 4 story cyborg factory. As players move from level to level they will encounter various devices being used to infuse the cyborgs with life. Blow open the wrong device and the factory will fill with disembodied cyborg souls. Gameplay is fast and furious.

dm-dbs.rfl.story: DOC'S BEATDOWN STATION (file name DM-DBS) by RED JUSTICE This is a beatdown map. Gameplay takes place in a long thin set of passageways connected by cross-tunnels. At each end of the complex you will find teleport switches that teleport all players in the map to a special killing room. The only way into this room is through the teleport. Flying around the map are surveilance robots. They are normally harmless but will kill if they trap a player against a wall. This is a beatdown map with plenty of riot baton batteries and riot shields scattered around. TECHNICAL: I built this map on the shell of part of the single player game I extracted. The music is from RF Beat2 made by Escaflowne by...
